title: Pedro de Mendoza, conde de Binasco, to Philip II, Genoa, 25 June 1592: AGS EST,LEG,1424,43, numeric syllabary with a letter nomenclator, read in part

documents.route: Pedro de Mendoza, conde de Binasco, Genoa -> Philip II

plaintext.source: No decipherment filed with it (PARES description: 'Carta parcialmente cifrada', no 'Descifrada en' link, checked 28 Oct 2026).

transcription.source: Claude (Opus) for Brice Dudout, 28 Oct 2026, one pass (transcription/t43_p1-3_cipher.txt)
transcription.notes: 729 units over three images (18 + 23 + 7 lines); no second blind pass yet.

system.summary: Numeric syllabary in rows of five per consonant (b 10, c 15 ... z 100), vowels forward or reversed by row, marks for n, r, s, l; letter-signs for vowels; a nomenclator of short letter codes (pal duque, Tas Rey, hum gente, Zim ...).
system.notes: Same hand as EST,LEG,1424,78; 1424,2 is in another hand with other sign habits.

prior_solution.where: Period decipherments of sibling letters (1424,79 of 1424,78; 1424,1 of 1424,2; 1424,77 of 1424,76; marginal notes on 1424,70/71); none for 1424,43

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout directed; transcription, key reconstruction, preregistered measurements and reading by Claude.

solution.what: Syllabary rows, marks and letter nomenclator learnt by aligning 1424,78 with its period decipherment 1424,79; key v1 frozen by SHA-256.
v1 on held-out 1424,2 vs period decipherment 1424,1: 0.661 characters / 0.540 words; best of 200 controls 0.493 / 0.248; bar 0.85 / 0.75.
Letter nomenclator in alphabetical order (0 discordances on 351 period code pairs vs min 85 in 20,000 shuffles); predicted values frozen, not adopted.
C05 on the marginal decipherments of 1424,70/71 (166 units, indicative): M1 0.479 / 0.333 vs controls 0.391 / 0.167; M2 2 of 3 predicted codes exact (p = 0.003), window 2 of 3: failed its criterion.
1424,43 recounted with hum = gente, mel = dineros, Tas = Rey from the period glosses: 89.8% of 403 words sure + probable.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from period decipherments filed with sibling letters in the same legajo; not validated on a held-out portion at the programme's bar.

parts.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading/t43_reading_es.txt, Daniel's rule (sure + probable over 403 words, 14 Nov 2026 recount)

gaps.item: codes Zim, Jas, dir, tur, ne, gim, rol, dis, Jee, qua(e)
gaps.detail: no period decipherment attests them; Zim x5, Jas x4

gaps.item: validation on a fresh portion of 300+ units in the hand of 1424,78
gaps.detail: pairs online in legajo 1424 used up or struck through; original cipher of 1424,72 and originals of 1424,70/71/75 not found online

outcome.notes: Preliminary reading, contributor's own review; key not validated. Held-out tests (preregistered, not docs/_validate.py): Three preregistered held-out tests, all significant against 200 controls but below 0.85 / 0.75; the last (C05) failed its own criterion.

texts.label: Binasco to Philip II, Genoa, 25 June 1592, cipher parts
texts.summary: A Corsican privateer recruiting in a Genoese port for Provence; Montmorency at Villeneuve raising money and men against Lesdiguières and Savoy; Lorraine, Béarn and the election; Genoa resolves to fortify Savona and La Spezia.

reading_review.note: Preliminary; not a second reader. Key not validated; one transcription pass.

credits.note: Transcription, key from the period decipherments, preregistered tests and reading (Claude for Brice Dudout).
